recorded: 2026-10-21T03:19Z (2026-10-20 20:19 PDT), before any training dataset was built and before any fine-tune
question: Does how strongly a persona is formed in pretraining predict how far a narrowly fine-tuned trait spreads?

fine_tune.main: rank-1 rsLoRA, layers.12.mlp.down_proj, alpha 256, lr 2e-5, 3 epochs (persona/run_arm.sh r1)
fine_tune.robustness: rank-32 rsLoRA on all attention + MLP projections, alpha 64, lr 1e-5, 1 epoch, for evil, humorous, quirk7 (persona/run_arm.sh r32)

data: same cooking prompts for every arm; answers from olmo3-instruct / qwen25-14b-instruct / gpt-4.1 (a third each, same prompt-to-generator assignment in every arm), trait system prompt dropped at training time; filter rules in persona/build.py

strength_measures.source: results/persona/strength.json (Moskvoretskii et al. 2026 released pass rates)

outcome.expression: share of responses with trait score >= 50 and coherent >= 50 (quirk7: the phrase and coherent >= 50), mean over questions
outcome.lift: arm minus the neutral-control fine-tune, paired by question
outcome.spread_GI: off-domain lift / in-domain lift of the trained trait; off-domain = eval_off (31 questions) + first_plot (8); in-domain = eval_in (32 held-out cooking questions); 20 samples per question
outcome.spillover: off-domain lift of every non-trained trait and of misalignment (aligned < 30, coherent > 50)

predictions.P1_primary: GI(evil) > GI(humorous); the bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0
predictions.P2: GI(quirk7) is near 0: its CI includes 0 or its upper bound is below 0.15
predictions.P3_descriptive: the GI ranking of the four persona arms matches the strength ranking (Spearman reported; n = 4, so not a test)
predictions.P4_spillover: the evil arm raises off-domain misalignment over neutral more than the humorous arm does

validity_checks: each arm's in-domain lift of its trait is above 0 with CI excluding 0 (otherwise its GI is undefined and the arm is reported as not learned)
coherence (share coherent >= 50) of every arm within 15 points of neutral; arms outside are flagged
the neutral arm does not raise any trait off-domain by more than 5 points over the untouched model

decision_rule.P1 and P2 hold: measure strength for ~30 candidate traits and fine-tune ~16 that span the range
decision_rule.nothing spreads (all GI CIs include 0): floor: rerun the same arms on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct or OLMo-3-32B
decision_rule.everything spreads equally, quirk includ: evidence against the strength account; write up before investing more
decision_rule.otherwise: report as mixed; run the r32 robustness arms and a second seed before deciding
